summary: Owner request (2026-11-05): a typed reference relation and the Dei Filius ch. 1 / can. I.1 parallel against the WF-P1 reconstruction. NamingPractice adds names, a practice-use reference relation and referential confession to the fideism Practice. Certified: with can. I.1 (stated) and the definition bridge (open), internal grammar + grammar-fixed reference + no-being is inconsistent; WF-P1 escapes by rejecting grammar-fixed reference (certified model). Link schemas show the rival conflicts with the nominal-identification leaves exactly where a being fits their descriptions. The rival is therefore not refuted: the defeat is conditional on two open bridges and binds only a fideist holding WF-P2's reference thesis. Rejected: identifying the practice-use reference with the leaves' proper-sense application (kept apart in DISAMB-NAME-APPLICATION).
blocker: To refute WF-P1 itself, an argument would need either grammar-fixed reference as an established premise or another route from the practice's correct confession to reference; and STMT-CONCILIAR-DEFINITION-IS-PRACTICE-OWN-STANDARD would have to be established.
